newsitem.title: LATVIA: PARLIAMENT PANEL BACKS NEW STATISTICS LAW.
newsitem.headline: PARLIAMENT PANEL BACKS NEW STATISTICS LAW.

text.p: The budget and finance committee on Tuesday gave its backing for a new statistics law to be sent to parliament for its first reading, politicians said.
The aim of the new law is to update previous legislation, introduced in 1993, and make it closer to European Union norms.

"The changes (in the law) have been drawn up taking into account changes in the economic process and the need to bring Latvian legislation in line with EU requirements," Economy Minister Guntar Krasts said in a note to the law.
He said the law also made some terms more precise, defined the confidentiality of statistical data and introduced changes that were suggested by the EU statistics office, Eurostat.
The first reading of the law is expected to take place on May 15 or May 21.
